thread:
alex: Quick heads-up — opened a TF PR to adjust subnet egress routing and add a PrivateLink endpoint for the metrics-collector. Plan looks mostly clean but I'm unsure about route table association ordering; could temporarily blackhole traffic during rollout. PTAL: https://git.link/pr/123

maria: Looking now. Which subnets are we changing (public vs app-egress)?

alex: Only the app-egress subnets in us-west-2 (10.4.64.0/20 + sibling /20s). The change creates an `aws_vpc_endpoint` for the metrics service and reorders a couple `aws_route_table_association` resources in `terraform:modules/vpc/egress`.

jin: Major thing to watch: if we create the association before the endpoint is fully functional (and before TGW route propagation completes) we can get transient blackholes. Can we gate the association on the endpoint health? Suggest `depends_on = [aws_vpc_endpoint.metrics]` or a `null_resource` wait that polls the endpoint status.

sophie: Also — the endpoint ID is consumed by the k8s consumer manifest. We shouldn't bake raw IDs into code. Plan to write the endpoint id to SSM/Secrets Manager and have k8s read it.

alex: Agreed. Proposed SSM snippet I'm adding to PR:
```
resource "aws_ssm_parameter" "metrics_pl_id" {
  name  = "/redwood/metrics/privatelink-id"
  type  = "String"
  value = aws_vpc_endpoint.metrics.id
}
```

maria: LGTM but ensure the parameter is encrypted with our KMS key (`kms_key_id`) and set `overwrite = true` for safe redeploys. Also we'll need an IRSA-backed IAM policy so the metrics pod can read it.

jin: About NAT/EIP handling: PR currently allocates EIPs with `count = var.az_count` and associates them immediately. For canary we should allocate EIPs ahead of time but delay association until the safe switch window. If terraform replaces an EIP association mid-rollout, long-lived TCP connections could break. Suggest: create `aws_eip` resources but only attach via `aws_eip_association` after smoke checks pass.

sophie: :thumbsup: Add a short k8s `Job` that curls the metrics endpoint over the privatelink to validate the path before we update production route tables. Put it under `infra/k8s/jobs/canary-privatelink.yaml`.

alex: Will update the branch: adding `depends_on` for the associations, SSM param with `kms_key_id`, and a `null_resource`-driven canary attachment workflow so association is manual/conditional. Also adding the smoke job manifest and a tiny make target to run it.

deploy-bot: Deploy check — terraform plan for `modules/vpc/egress` (workspace: staging) finished: 0 deletions, 4 additions, 2 changes. Plan URL: https://ci.company/plan/456

maria: Thanks. @alex after you push changes I will run `terraform plan -target=aws_route_table_association` and validate the ordering. If all looks good we can do a staged canary in staging then roll to prod during the maintenance window.

alex: Thanks team — pushing updates now, will ping when CI plan is good.
